data.body: [P1] A handler-scope `VirtualMachineError` or `ThreadDeath` can still be lost after invocation-end dispatch begins. This returns the selected `PENDING`/`RETRYING` outcome from inside the `ExecutionManager` try-with-resources, with no `scopeFatal` check after end hooks or manager shutdown. If cleanup reports a fatal while either is blocked, the worker dies but the Lambda caller returns normally. Store the result or exception, close the manager, then call `throwIfScopeFatal(scopeFatal)` before returning or rethrowing; update the blocked-end/shutdown regression to require caller propagation.
